findings.spec_constraint: Alphanumeric, max 52 characters; conditionally required on trade and collateral submissions
findings.evidence_quote: The unique code Counterparty 1 assigns to the portfolio when initial-margin collateral is reported on a portfolio basis, where applicable.
findings.reasoning: MAS provides a specific data element in its field specifications (Row 83) to report the collateral portfolio code for initial margin. The MAS guidelines also explicitly confirm that separate collateral portfolio codes may be indicated for initial and variation margin.

findings.spec_constraint: Alphanumeric, max 52 characters; required on all trade and collateral submissions
findings.evidence_quote: The unique code Counterparty 1 assigns to the portfolio when variation-margin collateral is reported on a portfolio basis, where applicable.
findings.reasoning: MAS provides a distinct data element in its field specifications (Row 84) to report the collateral portfolio code for variation margin. The regulatory reporting framework fully accommodates distinct codes for initial margin and variation margin.
